name: archive-master-extension
description: Metadata-only Chromium bridge for indexing and exporting Suno song metadata

scripts.package:chrome: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/archive-master-chrome.zip',{force:true})" && node build.js chrome && npx bestzip dist/archive-master-chrome.zip dist/chrome/
scripts.package:firefox: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/archive-master-firefox.zip',{force:true})" && node build.js firefox && npx bestzip dist/archive-master-firefox.zip dist/firefox/
scripts.package:all: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/archive-master-chrome.zip',{force:true})" && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/archive-master-firefox.zip',{force:true})" && node build.js all && npx bestzip dist/archive-master-chrome.zip dist/chrome/ && npx bestzip dist/archive-master-firefox.zip dist/firefox/
